model_annotations.Bulgarian: Фигура 8(c) е стълбовидна диаграма, която илюстрира разпределението на съотношението на разклоняване (Branching Ratio) γb спрямо броя на примерите. Хоризонталната ос представлява броя на примерите, вариращ от 0 до 500, с равномерни интервали от 100. Вертикалната ос представлява плътността на вероятността (Probability Density), с диапазон от 0 до 0.0008, с равномерни интервали от 0.0002. Диаграмата съдържа три стълба, представляващи различни условия: „Correct“, „Incorrect“ и „Correct“. Стълбовете са подредени по броя на примерите, като всеки стълб представлява плътността на вероятността за съответното условие при даден брой примери. Стълбовете „Correct“ и „Incorrect“ показват тенденция на намаляване на плътността на вероятността с увеличаване на броя на примерите, докато стълбът „Correct“ остава сравнително постоянен. Стълбовете не са визуално подчертани по никакъв начин.
model_annotations.English: Figure 8(c) illustrates the relationship between branching ratio (γB) and the number of few-shot examples. The horizontal axis represents the number of few-shot examples, labeled “Number of Shots,” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8 and tick marks at integer values. The vertical axis represents the branching ratio (γB), labeled “Branching Ratio γB,” with a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.70 and tick marks at intervals of 0.10. Three lines are displayed, each representing a different model: “fewshot” in blue, “correct” in orange, and “incorrect” in gray. The “fewshot” line begins at approximately 0.15 with 0 shots, rises to a peak of approximately 0.60 at 4 shots, and then declines to approximately 0.40 at 8 shots. The “correct” line starts at approximately 0.05 with 0 shots, increases to a peak of approximately 0.50 at 4 shots, and then decreases to approximately 0.30 at 8 shots. The “incorrect” line begins at approximately 0.02 with 0 shots, rises to a peak of approximately 0.30 at 4 shots, and then declines to approximately 0.15 at 8 shots. The lines are not sorted in any apparent order, and no bars or data points are visually emphasized.
model_annotations.German: Figure 8(c) presents a bar graph illustrating the ratio of branching, denoted as γb/γc, across different prompting styles: zero-shot, few-shot, and active. The horizontal axis represents the prompting style, labeled as “zero-shot,” “few-shot,” and “active,” arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis is labeled “Branching Ratio γb/γc” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Three vertical bars correspond to each prompting style, colored in shades of blue. The “zero-shot” bar has a value of approximately 0.22, the “few-shot” bar reaches a value of approximately 0.82, and the “active” bar has a value of approximately 0.92. The bars are not visually highlighted with any specific shading, borders, or annotations.
